items.source: The GeneratorStrategy in use does not currently, but may in the future, affect the caching of classes generated by AbstractClassGenerator, so this is a reminder that you should correctly implement equals and hashCode to avoid generating too many classes.
items.translation: 当前使用的 `GeneratorStrategy` 尚未影响，但未来可能会影响由 AbstractClassGenerator 生成的类的缓存，因此这是一个提醒：您应正确实现 `equals` 和 `hashCode`，以避免生成过多的类。

items.source: The GeneratorStrategy is responsible for taking a ClassGenerator and producing a byte array containing the data for the generated Class. By providing your own strategy you may examine or modify the generated class before it is loaded. Typically this will be accomplished by subclassing DefaultGeneratorStrategy and overriding the appropriate protected method.
items.translation: GeneratorStrategy 负责接收一个 ClassGenerator，并生成包含所创建的 Class 数据的字节数组。通过提供自己的策略，您可以在类加载之前检查或修改生成的类。通常，这可以通过继承 DefaultGeneratorStrategy 并覆盖相应的受保护方法来实现。

items.source: equals in class Object
items.translation: `equals` 在类 `Object` 中

items.source: cg - a class generator on which you can call ClassGenerator.generateClass(ClassVisitor)
items.translation: `cg` - 一个类生成器，您可以在其上调用 `ClassGenerator.generateClass(ClassVisitor)`。

items.source: a byte array containing the bits of a valid Class
items.translation: 一个包含有效类的位的字节数组
